verses.zh: 你不要嫉妒恶人，也不要起意与他们相处；
verses.kjv: Be not thou envious against evil men, neither desire to be with them.
verses.en: Do not be jealous of bad people, or want to be with them,

verses.zh: 因为，他们的心图谋强暴，他们的口谈论奸恶。
verses.kjv: For their heart studieth destruction, and their lips talk of mischief.
verses.en: because their hearts plan violence, and their lips talk about causing trouble.

verses.zh: 房屋因智慧建造，又因聪明立稳；
verses.kjv: Through wisdom is an house builded; and by understanding it is established:
verses.en: A house is built with wisdom, and it is made solid with understanding.

verses.zh: 其中因知识充满各样美好宝贵的财物。
verses.kjv: And by knowledge shall the chambers be filled with all precious and pleasant riches.
verses.en: By knowing things, its rooms are filled with all sorts of precious and lovely treasures.

verses.zh: 智慧人大有能力；有知识的人力上加力。
verses.kjv: A wise man is strong; yea, a man of knowledge increaseth strength.
verses.en: A wise person is strong, and someone who knows things grows stronger still.

verses.zh: 你去打仗，要凭智谋；谋士众多，人便得胜。
verses.kjv: For by wise counsel thou shalt make thy war: and in multitude of counsellors there is safety.
verses.en: Go to war with a good plan; with many advisers you will win.

verses.zh: 智慧极高，非愚昧人所能及，所以在城门内不敢开口。
verses.kjv: Wisdom is too high for a fool: he openeth not his mouth in the gate.
verses.en: Wisdom is too high up for a fool to reach, so at the city gate he has nothing to say.

verses.zh: 设计作恶的，必称为奸人。
verses.kjv: He that deviseth to do evil shall be called a mischievous person.
verses.en: Whoever plans to do evil will be known as a troublemaker.

verses.zh: 愚妄人的思念乃是罪恶；亵慢者为人所憎恶。
verses.kjv: The thought of foolishness is sin: and the scorner is an abomination to men.
verses.en: Foolish plans are sin, and everyone hates a mocker.

verses.zh: 你在患难之日若胆怯，你的力量就微小。
verses.kjv: If thou faint in the day of adversity, thy strength is small.
verses.en: If you give up when trouble comes, your strength was small to begin with.

verses.zh: 人被拉到死地，你要解救；人将被杀，你须拦阻。
verses.kjv: If thou forbear to deliver them that are drawn unto death, and those that are ready to be slain;
verses.en: Rescue those being led away to die; hold back those staggering towards being killed.

verses.zh: 你若说：这事我未曾知道，那衡量人心的岂不明白吗？保守你命的岂不知道吗？他岂不按各人所行的报应各人吗？
verses.kjv: If thou sayest, Behold, we knew it not; doth not he that pondereth the heart consider it? and he that keepeth thy soul, doth not he know it? and shall not he render to every man according to his works?
verses.en: If you say, "But we did not know about this" — does the One who weighs hearts not see it? Does the One who guards your life not know? Will he not pay each person back for what they did?

verses.zh: 我儿，你要吃蜜，因为是好的；吃蜂房下滴的蜜便觉甘甜。
verses.kjv: My son, eat thou honey, because it is good; and the honeycomb, which is sweet to thy taste:
verses.en: My son, eat honey, because it is good; honey from the comb tastes sweet.

verses.zh: 你心得了智慧，也必觉得如此。你若找着，至终必有善报；你的指望也不致断绝。
verses.kjv: So shall the knowledge of wisdom be unto thy soul: when thou hast found it, then there shall be a reward, and thy expectation shall not be cut off.
verses.en: Know that wisdom is just like that for you. Find it, and there is a future for you; what you hope for will not be cut off.

verses.zh: 你这恶人，不要埋伏攻击义人的家；不要毁坏他安居之所。
verses.kjv: Lay not wait, O wicked man, against the dwelling of the righteous; spoil not his resting place:
verses.en: You bad person, do not lie in wait near a good person's house, or wreck the place where they rest,

verses.zh: 因为，义人虽七次跌倒，仍必兴起；恶人却被祸患倾倒。
verses.kjv: For a just man falleth seven times, and riseth up again: but the wicked shall fall into mischief.
verses.en: because a good person falls seven times and gets up again, but bad people are knocked flat by trouble.

verses.zh: 你仇敌跌倒，你不要欢喜；他倾倒，你心不要快乐；
verses.kjv: Rejoice not when thine enemy falleth, and let not thine heart be glad when he stumbleth:
verses.en: Do not be glad when your enemy falls, and do not let your heart cheer when he trips,

verses.zh: 恐怕耶和华看见就不喜悦，将怒气从仇敌身上转过来。
verses.kjv: Lest the LORD see it, and it displease him, and he turn away his wrath from him.
verses.en: or the LORD will see it and be displeased, and turn his anger away from him.

verses.zh: 不要为作恶的心怀不平，也不要嫉妒恶人；
verses.kjv: Fret not thyself because of evil men, neither be thou envious at the wicked;
verses.en: Do not get upset about people who do evil, and do not be jealous of bad people,

verses.zh: 因为，恶人终不得善报；恶人的灯也必熄灭。
verses.kjv: For there shall be no reward to the evil man; the candle of the wicked shall be put out.
verses.en: because there is no future for an evil person; their lamp will be put out.

verses.zh: 我儿，你要敬畏耶和华与君王，不要与反复无常的人结交，
verses.kjv: My son, fear thou the LORD and the king: and meddle not with them that are given to change:
verses.en: My son, respect the LORD and the king, and do not join people who are always after change,

verses.zh: 因为他们的灾难必忽然而起。耶和华与君王所施行的毁灭，谁能知道呢？
verses.kjv: For their calamity shall rise suddenly; and who knoweth the ruin of them both?
verses.en: because disaster will hit them suddenly — and who knows what ruin those two can bring?

verses.zh: 以下也是智慧人的箴言：审判时看人情面是不好的。
verses.kjv: These things also belong to the wise. It is not good to have respect of persons in judgment.
verses.en: These are also sayings of the wise: showing favour when you judge is not good.

verses.zh: 对恶人说「你是义人」的，这人万民必咒诅，列邦必憎恶。
verses.kjv: He that saith unto the wicked, Thou art righteous; him shall the people curse, nations shall abhor him:
verses.en: Whoever tells a guilty person "You are innocent" will be cursed by everyone and hated by every nation,

verses.zh: 责备恶人的，必得喜悦；美好的福也必临到他。
verses.kjv: But to them that rebuke him shall be delight, and a good blessing shall come upon them.
verses.en: but those who correct the guilty will be glad, and rich blessing will come to them.

verses.zh: 应对正直的，犹如与人亲嘴。
verses.kjv: Every man shall kiss his lips that giveth a right answer.
verses.en: Giving an honest answer is like a warm greeting between friends.

verses.zh: 你要在外头预备工料，在田间办理整齐，然后建造房屋。
verses.kjv: Prepare thy work without, and make it fit for thyself in the field; and afterwards build thine house.
verses.en: Get your work outside ready and your fields in order — and after that, build your house.

verses.zh: 不可无故作见证陷害邻舍，也不可用嘴欺骗人。
verses.kjv: Be not a witness against thy neighbour without cause; and deceive not with thy lips.
verses.en: Do not speak against your neighbour for no reason, or use your mouth to trick people.

verses.zh: 不可说：人怎样待我，我也怎样待他；我必照他所行的报复他。
verses.kjv: Say not, I will do so to him as he hath done to me: I will render to the man according to his work.
verses.en: Do not say, "I will do to him what he did to me; I will pay him back for what he did."

verses.zh: 我经过懒惰人的田地、无知人的葡萄园，
verses.kjv: I went by the field of the slothful, and by the vineyard of the man void of understanding;
verses.en: I walked past a lazy person's field and the vineyard of someone with no sense,

verses.zh: 荆棘长满了地皮，刺草遮盖了田面，石墙也坍塌了。
verses.kjv: And, lo, it was all grown over with thorns, and nettles had covered the face thereof, and the stone wall thereof was broken down.
verses.en: and look — thorns had grown all over it, weeds covered the ground, and the stone wall had fallen down.

verses.zh: 我看见就留心思想；我看着就领了训诲。
verses.kjv: Then I saw, and considered it well: I looked upon it, and received instruction.
verses.en: I looked, and I thought hard about it; I looked, and I learned something.

verses.zh: 再睡片时，打盹片时，抱着手躺卧片时，
verses.kjv: Yet a little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep:
verses.en: A little more sleep, a little more dozing, a little more folding your hands to rest —

verses.zh: 你的贫穷就必如强盗速来，你的缺乏仿佛拿兵器的人来到。
verses.kjv: So shall thy poverty come as one that travelleth; and thy want as an armed man.
verses.en: and being poor will come at you like a robber, and going without like an armed man.
